scope: Existing adjacent Laravel 10 to 11, 11 to 12, and 12 to 13 guidance on schema 0.8. Section headings inside code fences are excluded.

classification_policy.implemented: An existing catalog rule covers the stated bounded metadata or source check; runtime behavior still requires application testing.
classification_policy.patch-correction: This completion patch corrects a demonstrated omission or misleading finding in the existing supported transition.
classification_policy.manual-review: The change needs application, database, deployment, or external-tool context that these bounded static rules do not establish.
classification_policy.not-applicable: Editorial navigation, estimated time, or optional tooling does not establish application compatibility.
classification_policy.contract-dependent: Custom implementations or overrides need signature and inherited-method review; a reference alone does not prove incompatibility.

historical_evidence_policy: This ledger is new review evidence. It does not replace the immutable transition matrix or signed release artifacts. Current Laravel 13 guide evidence adds conditional session-serialization guidance to the older pinned guide.

phpunit/phpunit.reason: The guide does not require a PHPUnit upgrade. Widening the skeleton review range preserves its recommendation and includes the framework's explicit application assertions/testing support; Composer still decides exact package/platform feasibility.

guide_package_advisories.doctrine/dbal: Review removal only when installed solely for Laravel schema operations; retain independent DBAL uses.
guide_package_advisories.spatie/once: Remove or replace the package because Laravel supplies the once helper.
guide_package_advisories.laravel/cashier: Publish cashier-migrations and review the Cashier package upgrade guide.
guide_package_advisories.laravel/passport: Publish passport-migrations and review password-grant enablement.
guide_package_advisories.laravel/sanctum: Publish sanctum-migrations and review configured Sanctum middleware.
guide_package_advisories.laravel/spark-stripe: Publish spark-migrations and review the Spark package upgrade guide.

external_tool_inventory.laravel/installer: ^5.6 when globally installed; outside analyzed application state

sections.reason: Document title.

sections.heading: Upgrading To 11.0 From 10.x
sections.reason: Catalog adjacent-10-11 establishes supported guidance; Composer and runtime outcomes remain independent.

sections.heading: Estimated Upgrade Time: 15 Minutes
sections.reason: Editorial estimate is not an analyzer effort promise.

sections.heading: Updating Dependencies
sections.reason: Guide dependencies are covered. Corrected the independent PHPUnit skeleton-default rule to include explicit framework-supported testing lines; PHPUnit11 is not mandatory. Review any globally installed installer separately.

sections.heading: PHP 8.2.0 Required
sections.reason: Target PHP floor is checked separately from the analyzer runtime floor.

sections.heading: curl 7.34.0 Required
sections.reason: Rule reports explicit curl absence. Verify target libcurl version separately; ext-curl's PHP extension version is not libcurl's version.

sections.heading: Composer Dependencies
sections.reason: All guide package ranges are inventoried. Solve exact installed/root constraints through Composer; these checks do not certify runtime compatibility.

sections.heading: Application Structure
sections.reason: Migrating the Laravel 10 skeleton is optional and discouraged by the guide; existing Kernel and provider wiring must not cause a mandatory skeleton migration finding.

sections.heading: Authentication
sections.reason: Verify authentication behavior and custom contract implementations using the child sections.

sections.heading: Password Rehashing
sections.reason: Test login with changed work factors and nonstandard password columns; set authPasswordName or explicitly configure rehash_on_login when needed.

sections.heading: The UserProvider Contract
sections.reason: Custom concrete providers need rehashPasswordIfRequired; inspect inherited implementations before claiming a missing method.

sections.heading: The Authenticatable Contract
sections.reason: Check custom implementations for getAuthPasswordName, including inherited traits; Laravel's standard Authenticatable trait already supplies it.

sections.heading: The AuthenticationException Class
sections.reason: Verify manually caught AuthenticationException redirectTo calls pass a Request; a variable method name alone does not identify the receiver.

sections.heading: Email Verification Notification on Registration
sections.reason: Test registration notification expectations; review configureEmailVerification only when automatic listener registration is unwanted.

sections.heading: Cache
sections.reason: Inspect deployed cache configuration and key continuity.

sections.heading: Cache Key Prefixes
sections.reason: Test DynamoDB, Memcached, and Redis prefix continuity; add the previous colon explicitly if the deployed key namespace must remain stable.

sections.heading: Collections
sections.reason: Review custom collection contracts using the child section.

sections.heading: The Enumerable Contract
sections.reason: Check custom Enumerable implementations for variadic dump arguments, accounting for inherited methods.

sections.heading: Database
sections.reason: Replay migrations against the actual supported database engines and inspect custom database contracts.

sections.heading: SQLite 3.26.0+
sections.reason: Read sqlite_version on target deployments; PHP and Composer extension versions do not prove the SQLite engine version.

sections.heading: Eloquent Model casts Method
sections.reason: Review model methods named casts for relationship conflicts and their inherited Model context.

sections.heading: Modifying Columns
sections.reason: Replay change migrations and compare retained unsigned, default, comment, nullable, and index attributes against the existing schema.

sections.heading: Floating-Point Types
sections.reason: Review Blueprint float/double arguments and removed unsignedDecimal/unsignedDouble/unsignedFloat calls; test resulting precision against the real database.

sections.heading: Dedicated MariaDB Driver
sections.reason: Switching to mariadb is optional; only when switching, review uuid columns for native UUID versus char(36) behavior.

sections.heading: Spatial Types
sections.reason: Review removed spatial Blueprint methods and PostgreSQL modifiers; test geometry/geography subtype and SRID behavior on each database.

sections.heading: Doctrine DBAL Removal
sections.reason: Package-presence advice is conditional. Manually review removed Connection/Schema/DBAL APIs and dbal.types configuration; independent DBAL usage remains valid.

sections.heading: Deprecated Schema Methods
sections.reason: Review getAllTables/getAllViews/getAllTypes and three-part table names; use native methods and an explicit connection, then test supported engines.

sections.heading: Schema Builder getColumnType() Method
sections.reason: Update expectations that rely on Doctrine type names; verify actual database type values.

sections.heading: Database Connection Interface
sections.reason: Check custom ConnectionInterface implementations for scalar, including inherited methods.

sections.heading: Dates
sections.reason: Evaluate Carbon upgrade behavior only if Carbon's selected major changes.

sections.heading: Carbon 3
sections.reason: Laravel 11 accepts Carbon 2 and 3; do not mandate Carbon 3. If upgrading, test signed floating diffIn values against application expectations.

sections.heading: Mail
sections.reason: Review custom mail contracts using the child section.

sections.heading: The Mailer Contract
sections.reason: Check custom Mailer implementations for sendNow, including inherited methods.

sections.heading: Packages
sections.reason: Package authors should test provider publication against both supported application structures.

sections.heading: Publishing Service Providers to the Application
sections.reason: For packages that edit config/app.php, test provider publication in a new Laravel 11 skeleton and use addProviderToBootstrapFile where appropriate.

sections.heading: Queues
sections.reason: Test queue transaction behavior and inspect custom repositories.

sections.heading: The BatchRepository Interface
sections.reason: Check custom BatchRepository implementations for rollBack, accounting for inherited behavior.

sections.heading: Synchronous Jobs in Database Transactions
sections.reason: Test sync jobs inside commit/rollback transactions with after_commit and afterCommit settings.

sections.heading: Rate Limiting
sections.reason: Review unit changes in manually instantiated limiter and queue-throttling objects.

sections.heading: Per-Second Rate Limiting
sections.reason: Convert explicit Limit/GlobalLimit and ThrottlesExceptions constructor intervals from minutes to seconds; review decayMinutes references. Static perMinute remains valid.

sections.heading: Cashier Stripe
sections.reason: Version and migration publication advice is present; package-specific behavior requires its own upgrade tests.

sections.heading: Updating Cashier Stripe
sections.reason: Review Cashier's separate upgrade guide and verify published migrations before deployment.

sections.heading: Spark (Stripe)
sections.reason: Version and migration publication advice is present; review the separate Spark guide.

sections.heading: Updating Spark Stripe
sections.reason: Verify package upgrade behavior and published migrations before deployment.

sections.heading: Passport
sections.reason: Version and migration advice is present; password-grant behavior is a separate manual check.

sections.heading: Updating Passport
sections.reason: Upstream duplicates the updating-telescope anchor here. Test password-grant requirements and explicit enablePasswordGrant separately.

sections.heading: Sanctum
sections.reason: Version and migration advice is present; compare actual config/sanctum.php middleware manually.

sections.heading: Updating Sanctum
sections.reason: Verify session-authentication, cookie-encryption, and CSRF middleware symbols and test stateful API authentication.

sections.heading: Telescope
sections.reason: Version and migration publication advice is present.

sections.heading: Updating Telescope
sections.reason: Verify Telescope migrations are published before deployment.

sections.heading: Spatie Once Package
sections.reason: Previously omitted package-presence guidance now identifies the documented once-helper conflict.

sections.heading: Miscellaneous
sections.reason: Compare application skeleton files selectively; apply only changes relevant to the application and do not require a new skeleton.

phpunit/phpunit.reason: Retain the guide recommendation while also respecting explicit framework assertions/testing support on PHPUnit10 and12; an upgrade recommendation does not establish that other supported majors are incompatible.

external_tool_inventory.laravel/installer: Update only when using the external installer; global Composer, php.new, and Herd installation state are not application state.

sections.heading: Upgrading To 12.0 From 11.x
sections.reason: Catalog adjacent-11-12 establishes supported guidance, independently of solve/runtime outcomes.

sections.heading: Estimated Upgrade Time: 5 Minutes
sections.reason: Editorial estimate is not an analyzer effort promise.

sections.heading: Updating Dependencies
sections.reason: All guide recommendations are inventoried. PHPUnit review range now includes explicitly supported framework testing alternatives; exact package/platform compatibility remains Composer evidence.

sections.heading: Carbon 3
sections.reason: Carbon 2 removal has a package rule. Test Carbon 3 signed floating date differences against application behavior.

sections.heading: Updating the Laravel Installer
sections.reason: Update the installer only when using it; verify global Composer/php.new/Herd separately from the analyzed application.

sections.heading: Authentication
sections.reason: Review explicitly instantiated password-token repositories.

sections.heading: Updated DatabaseTokenRepository Constructor Signature
sections.reason: Review custom construction/overrides and convert the expiry argument to seconds; standard container construction is not a defect.

sections.heading: Concurrency
sections.reason: Test concurrent-operation result consumers.

sections.heading: Concurrency Result Index Mapping
sections.reason: Test associative Concurrency::run inputs and consumers that previously expected numeric result indexes.

sections.heading: Container
sections.reason: Test application dependency resolution expectations.

sections.heading: Container Class Dependency Resolution
sections.reason: Test nullable class defaults with actual bindings; a null default alone does not establish reliance on previous injection behavior.

sections.heading: Database
sections.reason: Test schema inspection and custom database integrations.

sections.heading: Multi-Schema Database Inspecting
sections.reason: Test table/view/type listings and db:table/db:show across configured schemas; set schema/schemaQualified options when relying on earlier listing scope.

sections.heading: Database Constructor Signature Changes
sections.reason: Review custom Blueprint/Grammar construction and Connection subclasses; supply Connection and replace removed setConnection/withTablePrefix APIs only on verified receivers.

sections.heading: Eloquent
sections.reason: Exact removed-trait uses now have source-linked findings; UUID behavior expectations still require runtime tests.

sections.heading: Models and UUIDv7
sections.reason: Actual HasVersion7Uuids trait use requires HasUuids; unused imports and unrelated short names do not trigger. For prior HasUuids usage, test UUID version expectations and opt into HasVersion4Uuids only when needed.

sections.heading: Requests
sections.reason: Test application request-merge expectations.

sections.heading: Nested Array Request Merging
sections.reason: Test mergeIfMissing with dotted keys and any consumers that expected literal top-level dotted names.

sections.heading: Routing
sections.reason: Compare cached and uncached routing behavior.

sections.heading: Route Precedence
sections.reason: Test duplicate named routes in both cached and uncached modes; dynamic route registration prevents a global static precedence claim.

sections.heading: Storage
sections.reason: Inspect effective filesystem configuration.

sections.heading: Local Filesystem Disk Default Root Path
sections.reason: When local disk is not explicitly configured, test fallback storage/app/private reads/writes and configure the prior root only when necessary.

sections.heading: Validation
sections.reason: Test permitted image formats.

sections.heading: Image Validation Now Excludes SVGs
sections.reason: Test SVG acceptance requirements; opt into allow_svg only if application requirements permit SVG uploads.

sections.heading: Miscellaneous
sections.reason: Compare skeleton configuration selectively and test chosen changes; optional synchronization is not mandatory migration.

phpunit/phpunit.reason: Retain the guide recommendation while admitting framework-supported PHPUnit11 and13. PHPUnit11 below11.5.50 remains outside the review range; accepted review evidence is not a claim that the requested PHP platform satisfies PHPUnit's own requirements.

guide_package_advisories.laravel/helpers: Review legacy array_first/array_last semantics and Symfony polyfill conflicts; custom global helpers require separate source/runtime review.

external_tool_inventory.laravel/installer: Update if used globally or through Herd; installation state is external to the analyzed application.

sections.heading: Upgrading Using AI

sections.heading: Updating Dependencies
sections.reason: All guide recommendations are inventoried. PHPUnit review range now includes explicitly supported framework testing alternatives; PHP ^8.3 comes from the framework manifest and Composer still decides each test tool's own PHP compatibility.

sections.heading: Updating the Laravel Installer
sections.reason: Update the global installer or Herd only when used; this state is not in application Composer metadata.

sections.heading: Cache
sections.reason: Test effective prefix and serialization settings.

sections.heading: Cache Prefixes and Session Cookie Names
sections.reason: Only fallback-generated values change; inspect absent application config and effective environment values before testing cache/session continuity.

sections.heading: Store and Repository Contracts: touch
sections.reason: Check custom cache stores/repositories for touch and inherited implementation; standard stores are not missing-method findings.

sections.heading: Cache serializable_classes Configuration
sections.reason: Test cached object restoration with effective configuration; use explicit allowed classes or non-object payloads where required.

sections.heading: Container
sections.reason: Test method-injection expectations against actual bindings.

sections.heading: Container::call and Nullable Class Defaults
sections.reason: Test nullable callback parameters when no binding exists; review code that expected auto-instantiation instead of null.

sections.heading: Contracts
sections.reason: Review custom concrete implementations, including inherited methods.

sections.heading: Dispatcher Contract: dispatchAfterResponse
sections.reason: Check custom Bus Dispatcher implementations for dispatchAfterResponse with compatible parameters.

sections.heading: ResponseFactory Contract: eventStream
sections.reason: Check custom ResponseFactory implementations for eventStream with a compatible signature.

sections.heading: MustVerifyEmail Contract: markEmailAsUnverified
sections.reason: Check custom MustVerifyEmail implementations for markEmailAsUnverified, including inherited traits.

sections.heading: Database
sections.reason: Test SQL behavior using the target database engines.

sections.heading: Database upsert With MySQL or MariaDB
sections.reason: Test upsert calls with empty uniqueBy and supply a valid unique-key declaration; receiver and database context must be verified.

sections.heading: MySQL DELETE Queries With JOIN, ORDER BY, and LIMIT
sections.reason: Test joined ordered/limited deletes against real MySQL/MariaDB support; previously ignored clauses may now cause QueryException.

sections.heading: Eloquent
sections.reason: Test model boot, pivot inference, and queue serialization behavior.

sections.heading: Model Booting and Nested Instantiation
sections.reason: Exercise boot/trait boot hooks that instantiate the same model before its boot finishes; move that work outside the boot cycle.

sections.heading: Polymorphic Pivot Table Name Generation
sections.reason: Test inferred custom MorphPivot table names; explicitly configure a table when relying on prior singular inference.

sections.heading: Collection Model Serialization Restores Eager-Loaded Relations
sections.reason: Test queued/restored model collections when consumers depended on eager relations being absent.

sections.heading: HTTP Client
sections.reason: Review custom HTTP response subclass signatures.

sections.heading: HTTP Client Response::throw and throwIf Signatures
sections.reason: Check overrides for compatible callback parameters; a throw method on an unrelated class is not affected.

sections.heading: Notifications
sections.reason: Test notification text and missing-model queue behavior.

sections.heading: Default Password Reset Subject
sections.reason: Update tests/translations only where they depend on the old default reset-mail subject.

sections.heading: Queued Notifications and Missing Models
sections.reason: Test DeleteWhenMissingModels/property behavior with deleted referenced models.

sections.heading: Queue
sections.reason: Test typed event listeners and inspect custom queue-driver contracts.

sections.heading: JobAttempted Event Exception Payload
sections.reason: Review verified JobAttempted listeners for exceptionOccurred references; use exception object/null and adjust boolean assumptions.

sections.heading: QueueBusy Event Property Rename
sections.reason: Review verified QueueBusy listeners for connection property access and use connectionName; unrelated connection properties are unaffected.

sections.heading: Queue Contract Method Additions
sections.reason: Inspect custom Queue implementations for pendingSize, delayedSize, reservedSize, creationTimeOfOldestPendingJob and inherited implementations.

sections.heading: Routing
sections.reason: Test domain and domainless route matching together.

sections.heading: Domain Route Registration Precedence
sections.reason: Test explicit-domain routes with catch-all and earlier domainless registrations; static registration order alone does not prove application breakage.

sections.heading: Session
sections.reason: This section is newly present in current pinned guide; inspect chosen skeleton configuration changes.

sections.heading: Session serialization Configuration
sections.reason: Only changing session serialization from php to json while syncing skeleton config invalidates active sessions. Verify payloads and planned reauthentication; existing php remains supported.

sections.heading: Scheduling
sections.reason: Test application bootstrap scheduling timing.

sections.heading: withScheduling Registration Timing
sections.reason: Test code relying on immediate schedule registration; withScheduling is deferred until Schedule resolves.

sections.heading: Security
sections.reason: Exact middleware registration/inheritance references now produce advisory guidance rather than claiming deprecated classes were removed.

sections.heading: Request Forgery Protection
sections.reason: VerifyCsrfToken/ValidateCsrfToken remain deprecated aliases. Review exact direct references and test exclusions; test Sec-Fetch-Site origin checks and preventRequestForgery configuration separately.

sections.heading: Support
sections.reason: Test custom manager closures, string factories, and JavaScript rendering expectations.

sections.heading: Manager extend Callback Binding
sections.reason: Test manager driver closures that depend on bound this; capture required provider state explicitly.

sections.heading: Str Factories Reset Between Tests
sections.reason: Run affected tests independently and together; configure UUID/ULID/random factories in each test or setup hook when needed.

sections.heading: Js::from Uses Unescaped Unicode By Default
sections.reason: Review frontend/string snapshots that require escaped Unicode and update expectations deliberately.

sections.heading: Utilities
sections.reason: Legacy package-presence advice is implemented; global custom-helper and bootstrap-order checks remain manual.

sections.heading: Symfony PHP 8.5 Polyfill and Global Function Conflicts
sections.reason: Review laravel/helpers and custom global array_first/array_last definitions; test below/above PHP 8.5 and prefer Arr methods when retaining legacy callback semantics.

sections.heading: Views
sections.reason: Test directly configured pagination views.

sections.heading: Pagination Bootstrap View Names
sections.reason: Review direct pagination::default/simple-default references and use bootstrap-3/simple-bootstrap-3 where intended.

sections.heading: Miscellaneous
sections.reason: Compare and test chosen skeleton changes selectively; synchronization is optional.
